settings.heading: Honoring the Earth through Mindful Craft
settings.story_text: Every bar of single-origin chocolate begins with pure, ethically tended beans, stone-ground with patience. Alongside our confectionery, our traditional care formulations draw upon centuries of botanical heritage—harnessing pure botanicals, cold-pressed oils, and unadulterated roots.

settings.heading: Our Handcrafted Method
settings.description: Committed to uncompromised botanical integrity and traditional culinary patience.

settings.title: Ethical Sourcing
settings.text: Selecting raw cacao and native botanical herbs harvested in harmony with regional ecosystems.

settings.title: Stone-Ground Patience
settings.text: Refining cacao and medicinal herbs using traditional low-temperature stone mills to preserve volatile notes.

settings.title: Artisanal Purity
settings.text: Poured, tempered, and packaged by hand with zero synthetic stabilizers, artificial colors, or fillers.
